### Rise and Shine
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/rise-and-shine-one-year-devotions-for-men-february-10.html
Passage: Isaiah 60:1
Points:
- Like a bugle sounding reveille, Isaiah delivers a wake-up call to God's people to rise and shine.
- The prophetic vision extends beyond ancient Jerusalem to the new Jerusalem, the redeemed church.
- Believers cannot shine on their own; God must first pour His own radiance into their lives.
- Receiving divine forgiveness and eternal hope replaces guilt and worry with noticeable spiritual vitality.
- When Christians reflect God's inner light and love, people around them are drawn to Christ.

### God’s Nearness in Darker Evenings
Author: Amber Ginter
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/video/gods-nearness-in-darker-evenings-isaiah-6019.html
Passage: Isaiah 60:19
Points:
- Diminishing daylight during seasonal shifts can intensify emotional fatigue and feelings of loneliness.
- Isaiah assures believers that the Lord Himself will serve as an everlasting, unshakeable light.
- Scripture acknowledges the reality of painful seasons while reminding us that darkness lacks final authority.
- Believers carrying heavy burdens are encouraged to bring their emotional pain honestly before God.
- God makes His sustaining presence known through prayer, supportive community, and practical care.

### Our Everlasting Light
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-everlasting-light
Passage: Isaiah 60:19-20
Points:
- The complete removal of spiritual and physical darkness is a central promise throughout Scripture.
- Though created heavenly bodies are good, they ultimately point forward to the Son as the true light.
- Only a purified people can abide in God's radiant light, a holiness accomplished through Christ.
- The faithful await the consummation of all things, where the Lord's presence banishes every shadow.
- Believers are summoned to walk in this light today by loving God and actively serving others.
